title: Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi (Theme 8: Wanyama wa porini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child changes the end of the verb to show doing (-a), doing for someone (-ia/-ea) or being done to (-wa).
representations: a picture story: Mama anampikia mtoto; chakula kinapikwa
steps: Ask: does, does for, or is done to?

board.say: Mama anapika kwa ajili ya nani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "anampikia" and then the -wa form "Chakula kinapikwa na mama".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mwalimu ___ wanafunzi barua." Kwa nini "anaandika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kauli ya kutendea huonyesha kitendo kinafanyiwa mtu: anawaandikia, anampikia, anamsomea.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Barua ___ na mwalimu." Kwa nini "imeandika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kauli ya kutendwa huonyesha kitu kimefanyiwa kitendo: barua imeandikwa, chai imepikwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Hadithi ___ na watoto wote." Kwa nini "inasomea" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kutendea (-ia, -ea) ni "kwa ajili ya mtu". Kutendwa (-wa) ni "kinatendwa na mtu".

misconceptions.ask: Ni nani aliandika barua? Tunamtaja kwa neno gani?
misconceptions.repair: Mtendaji wa kitenzi chenye -wa hutajwa kwa "na".
